_about: Minimum metrics for tests/golden/samples.json (tests/accuracy/golden.test.ts, npm run eval -- --file tests/golden/samples.json --thresholds tests/golden/thresholds.json). Set just below what the rules scored on 2026-09-30 (see _measured). Raise a threshold when the rules improve; never lower one to make a change pass — fix the rule or the label instead. Precision / recall of multi-class fields are macro averages, so one mistake on a rare class moves them more than accuracy.
_measured: 2026-09-30, 74 samples: every field 100% accuracy / precision / recall except role_key (65 labelled): accuracy 98.5%, precision 98.3%, recall 95.8% (1 miss: en-nl-cloudeng-security-silent -> grc_cloud). visa confirmed precision 100% (19/19), role_match precision 100%.
